purpose: diagnosis of the pilot campaign that failed twice at the same point (DeepSeek, pilot site 3, repeat 1, Full branch, compartment 0, campaign second 13,787,100 = day 159.6)
method: deterministic replay of the model's campaign actions from the outbound audit (scripts/diagnose_campaign_failure.py)
finding: not a crop collapse: the carbohydrate buffer was 15,826 mg/m2 (minimum since planting -18.8), all state rates ordinary, smallest integrator step 0.0064 s. LSODA reported success but ended the 300 s step at 13,787,400.0000274 s, 2.7e-5 s past the step end, and the sensor bridge requires the solver end to equal the sensor event time exactly.
attempts: attempt 1 and attempt 2 failed identically because the fixed generation seed reproduced the same model decisions
fix: slowlab.cached_solver.snap_end_time: an end time within 1e-3 s of the step end is snapped to it and counted (settlement field solver_end_time_snaps); steps that end exactly are untouched, so every run that completed before is unchanged; gaps above 1e-3 s still stop the campaign as an infrastructure failure
contract: no contract change (the user had approved contract v9 only if the cause were a crop collapse)
